text: Socialite Melanie Daniels carries a pair of lovebirds across the water to Bodega Bay for Cathy, young sister of the lawyer Mitch Brenner, and [a gull strikes her at the wharf|threat|nature turning on us]. Over the following days gulls fall on a children's birthday party, sparrows pour down the Brenners' chimney, and [crows gather on the jungle gym behind the schoolhouse|images|animals and birds]. With [no reason ever found for the attacks|origin|no known source], the family drive slowly away past [a sea of watching birds|ending|the evil lives on].
